about: A row whose actions wait behind it at its end. A finger or a pen swipes the row aside, a trackpad's two-finger swipe does the same, and Tab moves to the actions with no gesture: focus opens them and Escape closes them.

inbox.about: Four messages at a phone's width. Swipe a row towards the start with a finger or a trackpad, or Tab to its actions. A swipe past half the actions' width leaves them open, and a press outside closes them. An action closes the row, then runs.
inbox.title: Inbox

label: Messages

rtl.about: The same inbox laid out right to left: the actions wait at the left end, and a swipe towards the right reveals them.
rtl.title: Right to left
